def maxCoverageAfterRemovingOne (intervals : List (Prod Nat Nat)) (h_precond : maxCoverageAfterRemovingOne_precond (intervals)) : Nat :=
  let sorted := List.mergeSort intervals (fun a b => a.1 ≤ b.1)
  let total := sorted.foldl (fun acc (a, b) => if a ≤ b then acc + (b - a) else acc) 0
  let max_single := sorted.foldl (fun acc (a, b) => max acc (b - a)) 0
  let min_total := total - max_single
  min_total
